name: Sai Aurum Heights
description: A landmark residential tower rising in Wakad, offering thoughtfully planned 2 & 3 BHK homes with resort-style amenities, landscaped courtyards, and excellent connectivity to the IT corridor. Possession expected in phases starting late 2027.

name: Space One Business Park
description: A Grade-A commercial development in the heart of Hinjewadi's IT hub, offering column-free office floors, dedicated parking, and round-the-clock power backup. Ready for immediate fit-out and occupation.

name: Sai Green Acres
description: An upcoming gated plotted development along Chakan Road, designed for those who want to build their dream home from the ground up. Wide roads, underground utilities, and a dedicated central park.
